correctness.rationale: Let eps=e^{-lambda d}. For fixed nbar>0, g(nbar/eps)=[ln(nbar/eps)+1+O(eps)]/ln2 and h2(eps)=[eps ln(1/eps)+eps+O(eps^2)]/ln2; therefore B=eps[6 ln(1/eps)+4 ln nbar+6+O(eps)]/ln2. Put y=lambda d and L=ln(1/delta); log inversion gives y=L+ln L+ln(6/ln2)+o(1). Eventual monotonicity justifies bounded integer rounding; prime number theorem gives the coarser prime leading term. Substitution into the source-stated O(d^2 m log m) complexity proves its sufficient scaling. Independent mpmath for nbar=1.4 and d=40,100 gave exact/leading asymptotic ratios 1.000000123839 and 1.000000000000005. No lower bound for true physical cutoff is asserted.
